packet_dag.terminal_condition: REQ-20260712-302 has shared module and service evidence; dedicated workspace actions remain split to later requirements.

title: Shared CRM workbench module and service slice

reasons: The addendum requires one shared CRM implementation for BNA, One Time, and future provider workspaces.
The current state already has a first-party CRM workbench, so this packet is a bounded extraction and contract-hardening slice.
The broad dedicated-contact workspace and persisted-action build remains too large for one safe UI batch.
likely_external_provider_blockers: live email and WhatsApp sends remain out of scope
full visual screenshot matrix remains required before claiming the whole CRM UI complete

operator_intent_summary: Make the existing BNA and One Time CRM workbench use one shared first-party CRM contract, remove internal/dead-end copy from the shared panel, and create reusable module/service boundaries without starting a second CRM app.
raw_quotes: Build one CRM product used by BNA School workspace; One Time Mishnah Class workspace; future service-provider workspaces.
Do not create a second CRM application, second Inbox, or second agent runtime.
Normal BNA and Rabbi CRM users must not see internal dead-end information.

decisions_captured.decision: This packet extracts and wires the shared CRM workbench contract only; persisted action breadth stays in REQ-20260712-303.

out_of_scope: No external email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, DNS, access-grant, import, or provider-account write.
No second CRM app or framework migration.
No broad visual redesign beyond shared workbench contract copy and module wiring.
No claim that all dedicated contact workspace actions are complete in this slice.
affected_surfaces: One Time Operations Contacts > CRM Contacts

inspection_targets: server.js CRM routes and SQL helper functions
known_current_defects: CRM route DTO construction is embedded in server routes instead of a reusable contact service.
Shared browser CRM workbench helpers are embedded inside the Operations monolith.
The profile panel uses internal empty copy such as Not loaded.
The workbench still displays no-send/locked language where a normal empty state should appear.
current_state.before_screenshot_plan: Source-level audit completed for this module slice. Full visual screenshot capture remains required before closing the full shared CRM UI requirement.

expanded_phrases.CRM: One first-party BNA CRM contract for contacts, contact rows, contact workspace, timeline, inbox context, empty states, and safe action states across BNA and One Time.
expanded_phrases.clean: No duplicate CRM app, no stale internal copy in the shared panel, and generated split shell remains synchronized.
expanded_phrases.professional: Customer-facing empty states use concise text and actions instead of implementation explanations.
expanded_phrases.working: Shared modules are loaded by the actual Operations page, server routes delegate to the contact service, and focused tests prove the contract.
expanded_phrases.launch-ready: This slice requires deploy and live smoke before being marked done; the broader CRM launch remains open.

requirements.statement: Extract the existing Operations CRM workbench into shared browser and server contracts used by BNA and One Time.
requirements.expected_result: BNA and One Time render through the same shared CRM module hooks and API response service.
acceptance_criteria: Shared CRM browser modules are loaded by /operations.
The CRM API routes delegate list and timeline DTOs through a contact service.
BNA and One Time workbench roots expose the same shared CRM component hierarchy.
Exact customer-facing empty states replace internal Not loaded copy in the shared panel.

criteria: Raw addendum is registered in the active execution run.
REQ-20260712-305 identity isolation dependency is done.
Existing CRM routes, workbench block, and generated split behavior were inspected.
Implementation is limited to one major surface and does not include broad CRM visual redesign.
External writes and persisted action breadth are out of scope for this packet.
